notes: Unit tests cover the retry and failure logic at code level. Live integration tests require a dedicated test Redis instance and BullMQ test infrastructure. The current implementation retains failed jobs in their original queues (up to 200 jobs) rather than moving them to a dedicated dead-letter queue. This is intentional for debugging and manual retry capability. Failed jobs are logged with appropriate error details and attempt counts.
